content.text: {"quote_faithful":"yes","verdict":"confirmed","evidence_kind":"missing_justification","fatal":"yes","explanation":"The quotation is verbatim and is used as the proposed mechanism for Theorem C. However, the write-up never proves that an arbitrary Liu partition can be refined into the stated paired shape using at most n new cuts. The assertion that an already partially cut stick leaves at most n required cuts does not follow: Liu’s cuts need not coincide with any of the 2n desired internal boundaries. The later binary-decomposition paragraph assumes integer lengths although Liu’s pieces may have arbitrary real lengths, and gives no cut-count argument. The preceding attempted induction explicitly reaches a contradiction and does not repair it. Checks only for n=1,2 cannot establish the all-n statement. Thus the universal upper bound D(M)≤1, and hence tightness of the claimed answer, remains unproved."}
